cases 124
case 0 help-long
args 1
arg 6
--help
config 0

progerr false
exit 0
stdout 1584
Usage of sst:
  -a	shorthand for --adversaries
  -adversaries
    	enable Romulan and Tholian adversary factions in standard game
  -anomalies
    	enable spatial anomalies & environmental hazards
  -audio-mode string
    	Set audio mode (auto, native, bell, off)
  -campaign
    	alias for --tour
  -classic
    	run in teletype plain mode
  -difficulty string
    	difficulty profile (casual, normal, hardcore, nightmare, expert, emeritus) (default "normal")
  -klingon-cloak
    	enable Klingon commander tactical cloaking
  -list-scenarios
    	display available tactical scenarios
  -mode string
    	theme color mode (auto, dark, light) (default "auto")
  -mute
    	Mute all audio playback
  -no-anomalies
    	disable spatial anomalies & environmental hazards
  -no-sound
    	disable retro procedural audio and sound FX
  -repair-multiplier float
    	subsystem repair duration multiplier (default 1)
  -s string
    	shorthand for --scenario
  -scenario string
    	launch specific tactical scenario
  -seed int
    	PRNG seed (0 for random)
  -sensor-degradation
    	enable two-tier sensor degradation curve (default true)
  -sound
    	enable retro procedural audio and sound FX (default true)
  -surveillance string
    	surveillance extent (full, classic, local, blackout)
  -theme string
    	initial theme name (modern, lcars, crt) (default "modern")
  -tour
    	Launch in Starfleet Career & Campaign (Patrol Tour) mode
  -v	shorthand for --version
  -version
    	print version information and exit
  -volume int
    	Set audio playback volume (0-100) (default -1)

stderr 0

model none
end
